statements.t: The Promotion Agreement was terminated in October 2026 and we will no longer generate service revenue.

We employ a targeted commercial field force calling on healthcare providers involved in the treatment of PAH in the United States, as well as key stakeholders involved in the distribution and reimbursement of medicines to treat these patients.
Under the terms of the Settlement Agreement, we will continue to market, sell and promote YUTREPIA for the treatment of PAH.

Under the Sandoz Agreement, Liquidia made a payment of $21.75 million (the “Sandoz Payment”) into escrow on October 14, 2026, which amount will be released to Sandoz upon Sandoz’s delivery into escrow of the documents necessary to dismiss the RareGen Litigation with prejudice and the entry by the Company and/or its affiliates into the Settlement Agreement.

We expect our research and development expenses to increase related to planned clinical trials and development of L606, however, levels of research and development spending are inherently uncertain and highly dependent upon the progression of projects and may vary.

We expect to incur significant expenses for the foreseeable future as we continue commercialization of YUTREPIA and advance our product candidates through clinical trials, seek regulatory approval of such product candidates and pursue commercialization of any such approved product candidates.
It is uncertain whether and when, if ever, we will realize sustained revenue from sales of such additional product candidates.

Additionally, our HCR Agreement contains fixed quarterly payments and minimum cash covenants that require us to maintain cash and cash equivalents in an amount at least equal to $45.0 million for the remainder of the payment term, which based on amounts funded as of September 30, 2026, is expected to conclude in 2033.

Our future funding requirements will be heavily determined by our ability to continue to successfully commercialize YUTREPIA and the resources needed to support further development of our products and product candidates.

We believe we will have sufficient unrestricted cash and cash equivalents to meet our financial obligations, including the settlement payments discussed above, and to comply with minimum cash covenants for at least the next twelve months.

We have included anticipated cash inflows from YUTREPIA product sales in our projections; actual cash inflows will depend on our ability to collect our outstanding receivables and the magnitude of potential returns.
We have based our estimates on assumptions that may prove to be wrong, and we could use our available capital resources sooner than we currently expect.

In the event revenues and cash inflows from YUTREPIA are insufficient to support our business operations and future capital needs, we expect that we would need further financing or we could be forced to delay, limit, reduce or terminate clinical studies or other ongoing activities, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, and financial condition.

In consideration for these exclusive rights, we will pay Pharmosa potential development milestone payments tied to clinical development and approvals in PAH and/or PH-ILD of up to $37.75 million, potential sales milestones of up to $185 million in North America and $150 million outside North America and two tiers of low, double-digit royalties on net sales of L606.

We are required to provide Lonza with quarterly forecasts of our expected production requirements for the following 24-month period, the first twelve months of which is considered a binding, firm order.

Under the supply agreement with LGM, we are required to provide rolling forecasts, a portion of which will be considered a binding, firm order, subject to an annual minimum purchase commitment of $2.7 million for the term of the agreement.

GTN adjustments are based on available information including the contractual terms with customers, historical trends, industry analogs, communications with customers, and the levels of inventory remaining in the distribution channel, as well as expectations about the market for the product and anticipated introduction of competitive products, in combination with management’s informed judgments.

Overall, these reserves reflect our best estimates of the amount of net cash proceeds we expect to realize from collection of current period gross sales less fees, discounts, and allowances and future estimated cash disbursements for the various GTN categories.
In accruing service fees, we estimate the time period over which services will be performed and the level of effort to be expended in each period.

Although we do not expect our estimates to be materially different from amounts actually incurred, our understanding of the status and timing of services performed relative to the actual status and timing of services performed may vary and could result in us reporting amounts that are too high or too low in any particular period.

estimates.name: Revenue Recognition
estimates.t: Net product revenues from the sale of YUTREPIA are recorded at the transaction price, which reflects gross product sales reduced by corresponding gross-to-net (“GTN”) adjustments, including estimated discounts, government chargebacks, government rebates, specialty distributor fees, copay assistance,…

estimates.name: Research and Development Expenses
estimates.t: As part of the process of preparing our condensed consolidated financial statements, we are required to estimate our incurred expenses.

statements.t: Simultaneously, we will continue to advance a pipeline that builds on our deep understanding of inhaled treprostinil, from L606 in PAH and PH-ILD to new indications where patients have no approved options, such as SSc-RP and PH-COPD.

Under the settlement agreement, Liquidia agreed to pay net $380.7 million in multiple installments in 2026 and 2027, inclusive of payments to other parties to resolve the antitrust litigation against United Therapeutics related to Treprostinil Injection, which the company expects to fund from current cash and cash equivalents and ongoing sales of YUTREPIA.
We will no longer generate service revenue.
